So, there is a girl in my school. I fell in love on my 9th std. I processed that inside me and confessed on my 11th std, when she was 10th std. She said no but she kept talking with me personally. Many guys proposed her but she just yell at them and block them. But she treated me different. For the next 3 months, we used to catch eye contacts and sometimes she used to blush by looking at me. All of a sudden, she just blocked me in social media and stopped looking me. I tried to talk with her in new IDs and asked her friends about this. I just needed a reason. How can someone dump anyone all of a sudden without any reason? But their friends said her male friends told her that I'm a very bad person and something like that. It's just broke my heart. How can she believe someone but not me. I tried to forgot her. But now 4 years after, still loving her even more than before. I started to pray to god, playing games, reading books, going gym, po*n, concentrating on job and so on. I tried everything to keep me busy, not to think about her. But it's not working. Each and every second, I keep searching for her. I keep checking the new notification, it can be her. Keep checking every bus, bikes, cars that she maybe inside. It's like I'm living in her world and sometimes coming to the real world while doing job or any work. The things I catched were insecurity, weak physical strength (because of po*n), zero concentration, anxiety. But on the other side, she is enjoying her college days with her roommates and collage mates. If you are reading this, I only need a closure 😭😭, I don't your love or anything. Just give me a closure. That's enough!!
